sampleResults.topFindingHeadline: Your Firm Possesses Strong Capital Demand But Operates on Fragile Tribal Memory
sampleResults.executiveSummary: You have earned trusted client relationships that generate borrowing requests, but deal velocity stalls because intake, status tracking, and lender handoffs depend entirely on manual human touch.

highestLeverageMove.headline: Replace Email Thread Inquiries with a Structured Intake & Qualification Link
highestLeverageMove.subheadline: Capture borrower data cleanly before requesting an introductory call
